title: JudgmentBench: Comparing Rubric and Preference Evaluation for Quality Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2605.25240v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Two methodologies dominate current practices of benchmarking: rubric-based scoring evaluates items against predefined criteria, whereas comparative judgment elicits pairwise preferences between outputs. Although both methodologies are widely used, the choice between them is rarely justified. We release JudgmentBench, a benchmark of 30 real-world legal tasks, paired with 1,539 rubric scores and 1,530 pairwise preference judgments collected from practicing attorneys--including at major U.S. law firms--with substantial experience. The annotations constitute the first publicly available dataset in a high-expertise domain in which both supervision signals are elicited from the same pool of experts on the same tasks. translated_title: JudgmentBench：比较量规评估与偏好评估的质量评估方法
translated_abstract: 两种方法论主导着当前的基准测试实践：基于量规的评分根据预定义的标准来评估项目，而比较判断则在输出之间引出成对偏好。尽管这两种方法论都被广泛使用，但它们之间的选择却很少得到合理的论证。我们发布了JudgmentBench，这是一个包含30个真实世界法律任务的基准，配有1,539个量规评分和1,530个成对偏好判断，这些数据由具有丰富经验的执业律师收集——其中包括来自美国主要律师事务所的律师。这些标注构成了高专业领域内首个公开可用的数据集，其中两种监督信号均由同一批专家在相同任务上引出。使用三个构建的不同质量级别的LLM生成输出，我们提供了初步的实证比较：在恢复预期质量排序方面，比较判断显著优于量规……
tldr: 论文发布JudgmentBench基准，汇集资深律师对真实法律任务给出的量规评分与成对偏好判断数据，首次实证比较发现比较判断在恢复输出质量排序方面显著优于基于量规的评分。
en_tdlr: JudgmentBench releases expert-annotated rubric scores and pairwise preference judgments on real-world legal tasks, empirically showing that comparative judgments recover intended quality orderings substantially better than rubric-based scoring.
